params.description: Limit the number of posts sorted by chronological order (1 to 1000000, default = 3)

params.description: Limit the number of threads returned. (1 to 1000000, default = 10)

params.description: Returns list of threads before this cursor

params.description: Returns list of threads after this cursor

params.name: entityLink
params.description: Filter threads by entity link of entity about which this thread is created

params.name: userId
params.description: Filter threads by user id. This filter requires a 'filterType' query param. The default filter type is 'OWNER'. This filter cannot be combined with the entityLink filter.

params.name: filterType
params.description: Filter type definition for the user filter. It can take one of 'OWNER', 'FOLLOWS', 'MENTIONS'. This must be used with the 'user' query param

params.name: resolved
params.description: Filter threads by whether they are resolved or not. By default resolved is false

params.name: type
params.description: The type of thread to filter the results. It can take one of 'Conversation', 'Task', 'Announcement'

params.name: taskStatus
params.description: The status of tasks to filter the results. It can take one of 'Open', 'Closed'. This filter will take effect only when type is set to Task

params.name: activeAnnouncement
params.description: Whether to filter results by announcements that are currently active. This filter will take effect only when type is set to Announcement
